dominant_strengths: Semantic color coding (green/blue/yellow/red) reads instantly and maps cleanly to notification severity conventions.
Restrained dark canvas lets the four colored pills carry the visual weight without competing chrome.
dominant_weaknesses: This is a button cluster, not a notification stack—no message text, timestamp, dismiss affordance, or stacking behavior visible.
Tiny 2x2 grid floats in a vast empty void with no anchoring, hierarchy, or relationship to viewport edges.
Brief promised 'improved' iteration but shows static category chips with zero motion, layering, or interaction signal.
fix_priorities: Replace pill labels with actual notification cards containing title, body, icon, and close action.
Introduce true stacking metaphor: offset z-layers, peek behavior, expand-on-hover for the 'improved' angle.
Anchor the stack to a corner (top-right typical) rather than dead-centering an isolated grid.
Add subtle motion cues—entry slide, auto-dismiss progress bar—to justify the 'system' framing.
rationale.norman_balance: Weak across all three layers: visceral is muted by emptiness, behavioral fails because nothing behaves like a notification, and reflective offers no memorable concept.
rationale.intent_fit: Does not fulfill the brief—this reads as a severity-level legend or tag picker, missing the stacked, temporal, content-bearing nature of a notification system.
